messages:
Meredith: Not my proudest WFH moment  tried to hide the router behind a shower curtain-looking tapestry and apparently created a Faraday zone. Calls dropped twice. Photo: https://images.redwood.example/meredith-tapestry-router.jpg :sob:

Ollie: 😂 The aesthetic vs connectivity battle. Does moving it 20cm help?

Meredith: Moving it to the bathroom-adjacent ledge helped a bit. Still saw blips. Running a ping during a freeze showed weird spikes:

Meredith: ```
$ ping -c 6 8.8.8.8
PING 8.8.8.8 (8.8.8.8): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=1 ttl=117 time=14.5 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=2 ttl=117 time=423.1 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=3 ttl=117 time=15.2 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=4 ttl=117 time=16.0 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=5 ttl=117 time=512.9 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=6 ttl=117 time=14.8 ms
--- 8.8.8.8 ping statistics ---
6 packets transmitted, 6 received, 0% packet loss
round-trip min/avg/max = 14.5/166.1/512.9 ms
```

Priya: Those spikes read like interference or a brief routing hiccup upstream. If it's correlated with you moving the tapestry, my money is on attenuation from fabric + metal grommets. Try raising the AP or putting it near a window.

Tooling Bot: network-monitor: observed meredith-laptop transient spikes at 2401234702 and 2401234765; peak RTT 513ms, 4 retransmits in 25m. Suggested actions: move AP out of enclosure, prefer 5GHz for short-range, or tether if urgent.

DevOps Dog: Woof. If you want a temporary mount, velcro + command strips for renters. Also: name the router. I vote "TowelFi". :dog:

Ollie: If you have an old phone, put it into hotspot mode and stick it on a high shelf. Cheap and fast workaround.

Meredith: Poll time  react with :towel: for "TowelFi", :sparkles: for "Netbath", :phone: for "phone hotspot". GIFs encouraged.

Priya: Also check the router logs for retransmits and firmware updates. If spikes persist during the same minutes every day, could be neighbor AP channel scans. Use a Wi-Fi analyzer to confirm.

Meredith: Update: removed tapestry from around the router, raised it on a small stack of boxes. No drops in a 40m meeting. Victory pic: https://images.redwood.example/meredith-router-victory.jpg :tada:

Tooling Bot: network-monitor: meredith-laptop events cleared at 2401234818; no retransmits observed in last 20m. Marking issue resolved.

DevOps Dog: Woof. Congratulate TowelFi on its retirement. :party_popper:
